answer: Every answer carries a 150 POA bond locked to its key. Reveals arrive in random order, and a key unlocks its own reveal only after countersigning two earlier reveals; a missed turn slashes 50 POA. Two answers sharing one hash burn both bonds. A 1,000-clone farm locks 150,000 POA and still faces 2,000 verifications per epoch or loses 50 POA per alias each cycle - real capital and labor that honest keys never pay twice. Picture walnut trees on a knoll: each tree needs its own quartz patch of soil. No photocopy forest grows here; every alias pays full price.
